properties.description: reason_to_exist.rs: get_node and reasoning_report on a Requirement GOVERNED_BY a Decision (a parks ruling aside) carry reason_to_exist — each Decision's acceptance, its chain's verdict beside it, and its support (accepted_and_its_chain_holds, accepted, accepted_without_a_holding_chain, contested, not_settled, refuted, withdrawn) — read apart from delivery. propagate_from / propagate_change carry reasons_to_exist_lost (every Decision the walk leaves without a holding line, a seed included, with every Requirement it governs) and arguments_lost. SATISFIES and DEPENDS_ON declare argued_by (node_ref: refused dangling at write; reported dangling by detect_defects and the import); the claim's verdict is read beside the edge (argument on get_node's edges and on the satisfies / depends_on reply, argues_for in reasoning_report); a claim resting on the target's delivery along that very SATISFIES reads circular. satisfies takes evidence and argued_by, depends_on argued_by, and a re-draw keeps what the edge carried. derived lineage covers the owner's words chosen through a Decision (no value added). capture-intent, brainstorm and the served instructions say how to record both.
properties.name: A governed requirement reads its reason to exist and is named when it breaks; an edge names the claim that argues for it, read beside it; delivery argued along its own edge reads circular
